name: MAC-H-the-draw-trusts-a-latch-Update-sets
why: `hasLightSource` is set in the same Update that clears it, so on any frame the two agree - the mutation only matters on the frame BETWEEN the light leaving the hand and the next update, which is the frame this pin drives by hand (`the sprite goes the moment the torch leaves the hand`). Recorded rather than pinned twice: the arm that matters is the direct read, and it is pinned.

new: const att = Math.min(1, 1 - Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) / range);

name: MAC-I-there-is-no-floor-under-the-sprite

name: MAC-I-and-no-ceiling-either
old: for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) out[i] = Math.max(floor, Math.min(1, out[i]));

name: MAC-I-the-lane-decode-lands-on-a-screen-quad
old: const colors = this._pointColorData(count, true);   // EL1: the classic-space read, as the water takes
why: `_pointColorData`'s decode only fires under the enhanced-lighting LANE (`this._lane`), and every pin here drives a laneless state - so the two reads are the same array in this suite. The difference is a whole-frame one (a linear tint multiplied into a display-space quad) and belongs to the browser probe, not to a unit pin. Recorded rather than faked with a stub lane.
